[LOPQ.1.3] **Purpose (the capability boundary).** With an opaque type the rule
layer holds an unforgeable, inert token: it may match it and hand it to an
adapter, and it must not read, convert, slice, construct, or cross-confuse it
([LOPQ.3], [LOPQ.4]). All domain meaning — for a `Key`, all cryptography — lives
behind the adapter boundary. The seal is a compile-time guarantee: a control-plane
bug or a malicious rule cannot forge or leak the underlying value.
